issue.title: Cannot reach the first 256 addresses in specific VLANs

failure.body:
#### Description
Cannot reach the first 256 addresses in VLANs with specific prefixes other than <IP>/21 (e.g., <IP>/21)

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Deploy a t0 testbed with the VLAN prefix here https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/vars/topo_t0.yml#L60 changed to a prefix other than <IP>/21 (<IP>/21 in this issue as an example) and redeploy minigraph.
2. Add IP addresses on the ptf (e.g., `ip addr add <IP>/21 dev eth4` and `ip addr add <IP>/21 dev eth5`)
3. Ping the above-mentioned addresses from sonic switch.

#### Describe the results you received:
Ping to `<IP>` could get through while to `<IP>` could not. Tried addresses of `192.168.16.x`, none could get through.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Ping to both `192.168.16.x` and `192.168.17.x` is expected to get through.

#### Output of `show version`:
Observed the issue in 201911, 202012 and master branch on Broadcom, Mellanox, and virtual switch.

#### Output of `show techsupport`:

```
(paste your output here or download and attach the file here )
```

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
The issue does not happen for the VLAN prefix `<IP>/21`:
1. Deploy a t0 testbed with the default vlan prefix `<IP>/21`
2. Add IP addresses on the ptf (e.g., `ip addr add <IP>/21 dev eth4` and `ip addr add <IP>/21 dev eth5`)
3. Ping from sonic switch to both `<IP>` and `<IP>` gets through.

resolution.title: Update VLAN prefixed to avoid conflict with BGP routes
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: Update VLAN prefixed to avoid conflict with BGP routes
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8026

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The two-VLAN configurations use `<IP>/21` and `<IP>/21` as VLAN prefixes. Such prefixes conflict with the BGP routes (e.g., `<IP>/25`). It follows that part of the VLAN addresses may be overridden by BGP routes and become unreachable. This PR aims to fix the issue by avoiding overlap between VLAN prefixes and BGP routes.

#### How did you do it?
Update VLAN prefixed to avoid conflict with BGP routes

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verify that VLAN addresses are not overlapped with BGP routes and are reachable.
